principle_violations.reason: The PaymentProcessor class handles both the payment processing and order status management, violating the single responsibility principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the responsibility of order state management from the PaymentProcessor. This can be managed directly within the Order class or a dedicated OrderManager.

principle_violations.reason: Adding new payment methods or item attributes necessitates changing the existing classes, violating the open/closed principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Introduce abstract definitions for payment methods and item configuration to facilitate extension.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
